title: Viscous Drag and Terminal Velocity
sourceLocation: Owner's ChatGPT Library only; master source not copied to public GitHub
calculationModel: Source uses NBF simplified Stokes terminal-speed relation vₜ = 2ρgr²/(9η), neglects fluid buoyancy and assumes slow spherical Stokes-law conditions. Do not treat it as general parachute or large-drop law.
limitations: Source's 80 original stems, four options, answer letters and one-line explanations retained (PDF line wraps normalized).
The original figure-dependent MCQs have been visually verified against the NBF printed figures and now render V90 independent educational drawings in public practice; no NBF scans are published.
20 real-life/situation items Q61–Q80 are independent questions, not fabricated shared-stimulus groups.
The official framework verifies B-41 and B-42 as Summative/Understanding at topic level; no original MCQ is certified at individual SLO/cognitive level.
This is provisional PUBLIC self-practice, not an official FBISE exam, high-stakes assessment or cloud-saved grade.
Original previous central Test Builder remains 1,769 questions until a separate verified integration; the whole Unit6 stays planned.
Scientific review of all items and Stokes-model physical realism requires teacher signoff; numeric answer letters checked as a focused first pass.

questions.stem: Which property of a real fluid measures its resistance to flow?
